```{r}
library('quantmod')
adj = getSymbols("MMM", from="2017-1-1", to="2017-12-31", auto.assign=F)[,6]
```

Problem 4
```{r}
#(a)
logReturn = diff(log(adj))[-1] 
plot(logReturn)
```
Non-stationality is not obvious from this plot.
```{r}
#(b)
acf(logReturn)
```
```{r}
#(c)
Box.test(logReturn, lag = 20, type = "Ljung-Box")
```
p-value of 0.7459 suggests significant evidence of correlation.
